source_detail: PDS3 SHACKLETON_STANDIN_20M (SHACKLETON_STANDIN_20M.IMG): 2400x2400 LSB_INTEGER16, 20 m/px, DN*0.5+1.7374e+06 METER
layout: row-major, row 0 = +y (projection), col 0 = -x; uint16 little-endian; height_m = height_min_m + v/65535*(height_max_m-height_min_m); heights relative to the median rim crest

directions_deg_in_grid.note: angle in the (col, -row) plane, 0 = +col, 90 = towards row 0
